descriptions.notStarted: I should check up on Moppie, as he is waiting for his master who left him with the words "I'll be back" as he went on his studies.
descriptions.inProgress: I should find Moppie's master, Huckle, since he was the one that Moppie with the words "I'll be back" as he went on his studies. Huckle should be somewhere safe in Orbis Tower working on his studies ... but where exactly?
descriptions.completed: I found Huckle, who was diligently working on his studies at the Orbis Tower. He looked like he hadn't bathed in weeks.
